answer: Embodied Work Anchor: each identity must complete a physical task whose output embeds a saffron dye pattern generated by a hardware token with a tamper-evident seal. The token signs the pattern, binding identity to a unique object an operator cannot forge at scale without buying and physically operating one device per identity. Enforcement checks pattern freshness and seal integrity; attackers pay hardware, shipping, and manual labor per identity, making mass registration cost scale linearly with real-world effort.
